one_liner: A supervisory role leading a Loudoun County mental health case management team that connects residents and families with recovery-oriented services and supports.
fit_summary: This is a clinical-human-services team lead role, and such jobs typically require a human services degree, case management experience, and often Virginia DBHDS Qualified Mental Health Professional (QMHP) credentials. The posting excerpt does not list requirements, and nothing on file shows Daniel has case management or behavioral health experience. Daniel's people skills and public-sector consulting background are relevant but probably not enough on their own.
eligibility: The posting excerpt states no minimum qualifications. Open the full listing to check required education, which is likely a human services degree for this type of role.
Confirm whether QMHP or similar Virginia behavioral health credentials are required or preferred.
